baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يَغْفِرْ ... وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ ... جَنَّات links pardon, causative entry, and enclosed gardens.
baseline_models.mechanism: A harmful consequence is first covered in a way that protects its bearer; only then are the recipients moved from exposure into a cultivated, sheltered interior. Forgiveness and admission are two phases of one relocation rather than unrelated prizes.

activation_trace.role: Shielding the offender from an offense's effect supplies the protective first phase of the transfer.
Culpable wrong and its bad consequence identify what the protective covering interrupts.
Movement into an inside supplies the boundary-crossing second phase.
A garden screened by its growth makes the destination a protected interior rather than bare territory.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists pardon and entry as separate rewards.
changed_reading.after: The ayah performs a two-stage transfer: it neutralizes exposure to consequence and then places the recipients inside a protected living enclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَارُ وَمَسَاكِنَ places running channels beneath settled dwellings.
baseline_models.mechanism: The habitat joins opposed motions: water continuously moves and provision continues below, while inhabitants become still and at home above. The flowing layer is not ornament beside the dwellings; it is the unseen infrastructure that makes lasting rest possible.

activation_trace.role: Uninterrupted running supplies the moving substrate of the habitat.
Continuing provision turns physical flow into the sustaining function of that substrate.
Beneath fixes the sustaining movement as a lower, supporting layer.
A watercourse cleaving the ground gives the lower flow a durable channel.
Rest and familiar comfort supply the human state produced above the moving system.

changed_reading.before: Rivers and dwellings are parallel amenities.
changed_reading.after: The ayah imagines durable peace as still habitation continuously sustained by movement underneath it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذُنُوبَكُمْ is followed by running rivers and channels.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet gives ذنب both a culpable sense and the image of a tail, downstream end, or runoff. I infer a controlled reversal: forgiveness cuts off the harmful tail of action, while the later river imagery supplies a beneficent downstream continuity. The alternative is that the material branches are unrelated to the verse's ordinary sense.

activation_trace.role: Protection from an offense's aftereffect supplies the interruption of harmful continuation.
A trailing end gives wrongdoing a spatial after-part that can keep following its agent.
Runoff tails and valley ends connect that after-part materially to downstream movement.
Free running supplies the positive continuation that replaces the harmful tail.
Opening and widening until flow can pass makes the replacement a rerouting rather than mere stoppage.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness erases a record, after which unrelated rivers appear.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness arrests the damaging downstream life of deeds and the ayah replaces it with ordered, life-giving flow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ closes a sequence of release, entry, flow, and settlement.
baseline_models.mechanism: فوز can hold both escape with good acquired and the dangerous wilderness through which escape occurs. The closing phrase therefore gathers the preceding verbs into a completed crossing: exposure and peril lie behind, while a settled position has been reached.

activation_trace.role: Escape from harm together with obtaining good supplies the successful endpoint.
A waterless passage poised between rescue and destruction supplies the peril traversed.
An overwhelming magnitude prevents the closing adjective from functioning as empty intensification.
A settled position marks arrival after the exposed passage.

changed_reading.before: Great triumph names a static possession at the end of the list.
changed_reading.after: Great triumph names the whole successful crossing from consequential danger into a position where life can remain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early movement from utterance without enactment to an aligned, tightly joined construction gives the later dwellings an ethical architecture. A community whose speech and action bear weight becomes structurally habitable; the promised residence is the completed form of that integrity, not merely private luxury.

activation_trace.role: Spoken utterance supplies the stated commitment that still lacks load-bearing enactment.
Performed work supplies the enacted counterpart required to make speech structurally real.
Alignment on one level line supplies coordinated placement of persons.
Joining parts into a building converts coordinated persons into a load-bearing whole.
Tight compaction supplies resistance to gaps between the joined parts.
Actual dwelling turns the earlier constructional discipline into a habitable outcome.

structural_cues: 61:2-4 moves from saying without doing to an aligned compact building; 61:12 culminates in dwellings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: utterance, action, alignment, joined construction, and dwelling. Reader arrow: ethical congruence becomes social load-bearing capacity and then habitable reward. Live alternative: the battle-row simile and the later residences may remain separate images.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings reward correct conduct but do not resemble it.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings complete a constructional logic in which aligned speech, deed, and persons become a form of life that can bear habitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context first makes deviation something that happens to hearts, then gives faith the branch-image of secure cardiac stillness. The pleasant dwelling can therefore spatialize a repaired inward orientation: a heart no longer veering becomes a self able to settle willingly in a fitting home.

activation_trace.role: Departure from straightness supplies the inward dislocation that must be reversed.
The heart locates that dislocation in the person's interior center.
Secure stillness and trust in the heart supply the repaired inward state.
An object of rest and familiar comfort externalizes inward security as habitat.
The self's willing pleasure makes the habitat fitting from within, not merely attractive from outside.

structural_cues: 61:5 links human veering and divinely intensified heart-veering; 61:11 returns to believing; 61:12 immediately names pleasant dwellings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a veering heart, faith as secure stillness, and a comforting dwelling pleasing to the self. Reader arrow: repaired orientation is exteriorized as a place fit for settled life. Live alternative: inner faith and outer residence may be cause and reward without image-level correspondence.

changed_reading.before: A pleasant dwelling is an externally desirable property.
changed_reading.after: The dwelling is the outer shape of a heart restored from veering to secure, willing rest.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context activates two morally opposed coverings. The hostile cover hides truth and accompanies an attempt to extinguish light; divine غفر covers the fault while protecting its bearer, and it does so without preventing the light's completion. Forgiveness becomes a counter-cover: protective rather than obscuring.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the reality that hostile covering tries, and fails, to suppress.
Arrival at completion guarantees that protective pardon does not entail an incomplete or hidden truth.
Generic covering supplies the shared material operation whose direction is contested.
Concealing truth specifies the destructive direction of the hostile cover.
A covering that shields and preserves supplies the opposite, beneficent direction.
Protection from the offense's effect identifies the person, not the truth, as what is sheltered.

structural_cues: 61:8 places attempted extinguishing, completed light, and the unbelievers together; 61:12 later opens with forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: light, completion, truth-concealing cover, and consequence-shielding cover. Reader arrow: the shared covering image is intentionally reversed by its object and effect. Live alternative: the cross-root resemblance may be lexical coincidence rather than a designed contrast.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is an undifferentiated covering or deletion of fault.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness is the good cover that shelters the exposed offender while the truth itself remains fully luminous.

context_deltas.mechanism: The named trade puts wealth and the living self under costly effort, then 61:12 clears an adverse allotment and grants entry into durable habitation. Read commercially but not as a price equation, the sequence converts exposed finite capital into release from liability and continuity of residence.

activation_trace.role: Seeking profit through trade supplies the transaction frame.
Escape by separation supplies the first return: detachment from the threatened loss.
Exerting full capacity under hardship supplies cost and risk rather than effortless exchange.
Possessed wealth supplies finite external capital placed into the trade.
The living self supplies irreducible personal capital beyond possessions.
An allotted share activates the exploratory image of an adverse portion canceled from the account.
Admission inside supplies realized access rather than an abstract credit.
Settled dwelling supplies durable use-value as the positive return.

structural_cues: 61:10 names a saving trade, 61:11 names wealth and selves, and 61:12 sequences forgiveness before admission to dwellings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: trade, rescue, costly effort, wealth, selves, an allotted-share branch, and dwelling. Reader arrow: these form a liability-clearance and habitat-conversion model. Live alternative: trade is only an exhortative metaphor and the rewards remain gratuitous gifts with no account-like structure.

changed_reading.before: The trade is followed by two externally appended prizes.
changed_reading.after: The promised result transforms the whole exposure of wealth and self: adverse consequence is cleared and finite risk opens into inhabitable continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context word for punishment carries both punitive pain and a branch of sweetness in water or food. Its immediate answer in the focus ayah is not only non-pain but rivers plus what is wholesome and pleasant. The reward can therefore stage a sensory and moral polarity reversal from torment to sweet, sustaining habitat.

activation_trace.role: Painful punishment supplies the threatened negative pole from which rescue is sought.
Sweetness and pleasantness in water or food supply a latent positive pole inside the same root inventory.
Running water gives the positive pole a concrete environmental body.
Wholesomeness opposed to foulness broadens the reversal from taste to the quality of the whole residence.

structural_cues: 61:10 ends with painful punishment; after the action specification in 61:11, 61:12 answers with rivers and pleasant dwellings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: punitive pain and sweet-water branches under ع ذ ب, followed by actual rivers and wholesomeness. Reader arrow: adjacency activates the opposed branch as a designed sensory reversal. Live alternative: the sweet-water branch is diachronically or rhetorically inactive here.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely substitutes pleasant scenery for punishment.
changed_reading.after: The ayah reverses the material quality of the threatened world: painful عذاب yields to sweet flow and a habitat purged of foulness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah marks near support and opening as another beloved good. That distinction prevents the focus ayah's great triumph from collapsing into military success, while the opening and the focus ayah's admission still mirror one another as two thresholds: one near and historical, one opening into protected settlement.

activation_trace.role: Another after the first supplies categorical separation between the two promised horizons.
Heart-adhering love explains the special immediacy of the second, near good without making it the whole triumph.
Aid that makes its recipient manifest supplies the public historical horizon.
An opened closure and widened entrance supplies the near threshold.
Nearness fixes that threshold within an approaching horizon.
Admission into an inside supplies the corresponding threshold in the focus ayah.
Settlement distinguishes the focus threshold's durable destination from a near opening.
Escape together with gained good names the focus horizon as the comprehensive triumph.

structural_cues: 61:12 closes with ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ; 61:13 begins وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا and specifies near support and opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an explicitly other beloved good, near aid, an opening, and focus admission into settlement. Reader arrow: the demonstrative break separates but analogically pairs two thresholds. Live alternative: 'another' may append one reward bundle without establishing a primary-versus-near horizon.

changed_reading.before: The great triumph is equivalent to the community's imminent victory.
changed_reading.after: The great triumph is the deeper rescue-and-settlement horizon; near victory is a distinct beloved opening that previews, but does not exhaust, it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ayah's causative admission might sound wholly passive, but the closing context surrounds divine action with human helping, reinforcement, and a resultative change into manifest strength. Entry remains granted; its recipients are simultaneously formed through a reciprocal economy of aid.

activation_trace.role: Aid that also brings its object to manifestation supplies the reciprocal relation named by repeated helpers.
Confirming strength supplies the divine reinforcement answering human commitment.
Becoming marks an achieved change of state rather than a static label.
Strength through a supporting back makes manifestation depend on received support.
Rising into prevalence supplies the public result of that support.
Being brought inside preserves divine agency at the threshold of reward.
Escape with good gained gathers granted entry and supported agency into one successful outcome.

structural_cues: 61:11 uses active second-person believing and striving; 61:12 gives jussive divine responses; 61:14 moves from an imperative to help through divine reinforcement to a changed state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: active commitment, divinely caused admission, human helping, reinforcement, and resultative becoming. Reader arrow: these clauses describe reciprocal formation rather than passive compensation. Live alternative: they may simply be successive duties and rewards without a shared agency model.

changed_reading.before: Being forgiven and admitted makes the recipients passive beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: Admission is wholly granted yet belongs to a reciprocal process in which committed helpers are reinforced into a new, manifest capacity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links distant material branches across worship, punishment, aid, and opening. It remains valid as an activation because 61:12 literally foregrounds running rivers and the cited branches repeatedly supply swimming, sweet water, rain-relief, and water released through an outlet. Render it only as a packet-induced hydraulic analogy, not as a claim that every source word denotes water in context.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَجْرِى ... ٱلْأَنْهَارُ makes moving water an explicit mechanism inside the promised habitat.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or rapid movement supplies an opening image of unimpeded traversal.
Sweet water supplies the positive material latent inside the named threat.
Rain as relief turns aid into environmental replenishment.
Water issuing from an opened outlet supplies release from blockage.
Continuous provision makes the released flow sustain life rather than merely pass through.
A channel widened until it flows gives the scattered hydraulic cues a concrete focus-ayah mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The rivers are decorative abundance after rescue has already occurred.
changed_reading.after: Rescue itself can be modeled as a hydraulic transition from blockage and painful scarcity to opened channels, replenishment, and continuous provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The vertical comparison is unusual because it connects the focus preposition to a later victory branch rather than equating their referents. It remains anchored in the explicit below-rivers of 61:12 and the upper/prevalent image of 61:14. Render it as a spatial counterpoint: below and above have different functions, not as a cosmological hierarchy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِن تَحْتِهَا makes 'below' the location of life-giving flow rather than degradation.

activation_trace.role: Literal beneath supplies a lower layer that actively sustains the residence.
A watercourse cutting through ground makes the lower layer productive rather than abject.
Upperness and prevalence supply the contrasting public position of the supported community.

changed_reading.before: Success is simply elevation over an opponent, while what lies below is background.
changed_reading.after: The surah distributes success vertically: hidden support flows below, while public prevalence appears above; neither position alone is the whole victory.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant reading because it uses the packet's non-dominant ع د و mappings into counting and returning. It remains anchored in 61:12's dwellings, perilous passage, and جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ construction, and the mapping identities are explicitly packet-supplied. Downstream prose must call it an exploratory temporal contrast and must not claim that عَدُوّ contextually means counting or return.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَسَاكِنَ ... فِى جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ presents the endpoint as settled residence after the passage named فوز.

activation_trace.role: Recurring counted time supplies an episodic rhythm against which durable settlement can be perceived.
Return after departure supplies the cycle that an abiding home would end.
Dwelling and settlement supply the non-cyclical endpoint.
The dangerous passage between escape and destruction allows historical episodes to be read as crossings rather than final homes.

changed_reading.before: Near victory and final triumph differ mainly in scale.
changed_reading.after: Historical victory may recur as departure and return, whereas 61:12 imagines triumph as leaving recurrence for an abode in which one can remain.

strongest_changes: Forgiveness became a protective counter-cover that shelters the offender without concealing the completed light.
Running water and still dwellings became one infrastructure: continuous movement below makes durable rest above possible.
The speech/action and compact-building sequence made the promised habitat the completion of ethical and communal integrity.
The next ayah separated near public opening from the deeper rescue-and-settlement named great triumph.
The punishment root's sweet-water branch kept alive an exploratory sensory reversal into rivers and wholesome habitation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah repeatedly held productive opposites together: covering and disclosure, harmful tail and beneficent downstream flow, motion and rest, inner security and outer home, granted entry and active formation, sustaining below and manifest above. The packet's non-dominant mappings also preserved a deliberately contained contrast between recurring victory and settled residence.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the غفر/كفر cover reversal is rhetorically active or only a compelling cross-root analogy.
Whether the sweet-water branch of ع ذ ب and the broader hydraulic chain should enter downstream prose or remain reader-facing activation evidence.
How far the trade frame licenses liability and capital language without turning gift into a price equation.
Whether the non-dominant ع د و mappings illuminate temporal recurrence or are too form-distant for anything beyond an outlier note.
